verdict.rationale: Raygun ships AI features (AI Error Resolution built on OpenAI and Azure OpenAI), so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for this product. The pack has no statement or setting about excluding customer data from AI model training. Filtering sensitive data before sending and disabling IP storage are adjacent privacy controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
